title: The First Crash
topic: Hardware crash during a live stream
summary: EX_01 experienced a hardware crash during a live stream on a 2019 Dell Precision with a Quadro T1000 GPU. The crash was sudden, silent, and lacked any error message, leaving EX_01 frustrated and questioning the GPU's reliability.
compactScriptExcerpt: You know that feeling when your computer suddenly decides it's time to crash during a live stream? I did. On a 2019 Dell Precision with a Quadro T1000, no less. It didn’t stutter. It didn’t lag. It just… *poof*. Black screen. No error message. Just silence. And not the kind that’s cool. The kind that makes you wonder if the GPU’s even *trying* anymore.
